name: Pulse Lantern
description: Tobbin's lantern. Its pulse wakes sleeping ship machines and reveals hidden glyphs.

name: Cracked Lens
description: A palm-sized lens from an old ship lamp. Only slightly cracked.

name: Coil Spring
description: A very bouncy spring. Tobbin says it is load-bearing.

name: Brass Valve
description: A heavy brass valve wheel from the hull's old water pipes.

name: Core of Light
description: A Resonance Core that hums like a held note.

name: Core of Motion
description: A Resonance Core that never quite stops spinning.

name: Core of Memory
description: A Resonance Core. Looking into it feels like remembering.
